releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64

  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的

- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.0
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Motion sensitivity
- **Motion sensitivity X axis** and **Motion sensitivity Y axis** set how fast turning left and right, and tilting up and down go, from 25% to 500%. They are next to the motion inversion on each controller's page in **Input settings** and in the quick menu under Controls, and work for the motion of the device and of controllers
- They scale the turning speed the game gets, which is what aiming with motion uses. A tilt that is held still settles at the real angle of the device

### Updated to the latest Cemu
Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:
- **Wii U CPU on ARM:** fixes in the ARM64 recompiler that runs every game, for single-precision float stores (now faster too), division by zero, carry flags and a few wrong instructions. The default NaN mode of ARM is turned off to match the Wii U
- **Performance:** smaller Vulkan and GPU optimizations, like checking only the render state that changed, caching shader lookups and using the fast draw path more often

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.5.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.4.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.4.0): one executable that keeps itself up to date, the game's own menus played with the mouse, prompts that name your keys, and a faster renderer.

## New

- **One file: `CoD3SP_s.exe`.** FFmpeg's libraries for the sound and the films are built into it; nothing else to unpack.
- **Updates itself.** At every start it asks GitHub for a newer release; if there is one, it downloads it, replaces itself and starts the new version. Turn it off with `auto_update = 0` under `[game]` in `CoD3Recomp.ini`, or start it with `--no-update`.
- **New first start.** The console window asks whether this is a fresh install (choose your disc image, then the folder to install into) or the game is already installed (choose the game's main folder, the one with `default.xex`).

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.4.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.3.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

## New

- **The next mission after a win.** The console restarts the game between missions and hands the next one over; the port does the same, so a finished mission leads into the next one instead of closing the game.
- **A mission's briefing film can be skipped** with Space (A) once its level has loaded. On the console it always plays to its end.
- **Unlimited frame rate in levels** (settings menu, on by default). A level runs at what the machine can do, around 100 to 115 frames a second where it had 60; the menus stay at 60 and the films at their own 30. The game's speed does not change with the frame rate.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

releases.body:
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.

releases.name: 3.0.4 - October 20, 2026
releases.body:
* **New menu look!** The menus have been rebuilt with a fresh, modern style: a deeper purple header and footer, cleaner rounded buttons with soft shadows, a redesigned game list with a slimmer scrollbar and a clear highlight on the selected entry, new prompt windows, and more. The menu graphics are now drawn procedurally by the renderer instead of being loaded from PNG images, so they stay sharp at any output resolution
* **New controller status bar** in the menu footer, replacing the Wiimote battery icons. Each of the four player slots (P1-P4) now shows the type of controller connected (Wiimote, GameCube controller, etc.), with the battery level shown for Wiimote controllers and the Gamepad. releases.name: 3.0.1 - August 11, 2026
releases.body:
* Implemented a brand new Dynamic Recompilation (JIT) core for GBA games on both Wii and GameCube, built entirely from scratch. This is a from-the-ground-up addition, not a port - real GBA titles now run with plenty of headroom to run at full speed, well beyond what the interpreter core could sustain. Enable it from Settings > Emulation
* Replaced GameCube's old ROM paging system with a new ARAM/SD hybrid virtual memory pager - ROM data now streams   transparently from SD into ARAM and MEM1 on demand instead of needing to fit entirely in memory ahead of time, allowing the JIT to be possible (since it doesn't have to be aware of backing data location)
* Rewritten memory management for both Wii/GameCube, freeing up 8MB+ for a JIT Cache, while still allowing 32MB ROMs
* Added cheat code support for both GBA and GB/GBC games, using the Libretro .cht file format
* GB/GBA audio is cleaner and truer to the original hardware, with one less resampling step - it is now generated natively at 48kHz - instead of upsampled from 44100Hz (GBA) and 22050Hz (GB)
* Audio samples are now written directly into the output buffer with no intermediate mixing buffer in between, reducing audio latency

# FivePocket 1.2.0 — new menus

**Play the 2013 open-world classic natively on Android and the AYN Thor, from your own Xbox 360 discs.**
FivePocket is a static recompilation with a new renderer, not an emulator. No game code, data or shaders are in any
download: the FivePocket Builder makes everything from your own discs, on your own computer.

This release is for Android (FivePocket and the Thor Edition), the Windows builders and the Mac builder for iOS and Duo.
**iOS / Duo: new menus; Online next update.**

**This update needs new game code.** Run the 1.2.0 builder on your discs again and import the new package; the
1.2.0 app accepts only a 1.2.0 package.

  Mode, Sandbox, Online, Verify Game Data, Import Game Discs) over the loading-screen art from your discs; Settings,
  Controller and About keep the same tab strip on every screen size.
- **Verify Game Data** and **Import Game Discs** on the Play tab: Verify looks at every game file on the device again,
  disc by disc; Import opens the setup page (game code and both discs).

## Lemon-Project v1.2.1

A fix release. Thanks to **BitRanger** for the Quick Save/Load work and the save corruption fix (GitHub pull requests #9 and #10), each tested save by save on a real device.

### Fixed
- **Games no longer sit on a black screen when Nextendo Network does not answer.** With Nextendo on, a game waited for the server before it started: up to a minute while the server was down. It now gives up after a few seconds and starts offline, with the usual notice.
- **Game saves no longer get corrupted after a Quick Load.** After a Quick Save and Load, a game's own saves could end up with bytes of the previous save at the end, or with their end missing (Hollow Knight reported "Save Corrupted"). The game's own flushes now reach the file. (BitRanger)
- **Quick Save/Load works in many more places and fails much less** (BitRanger):
  - Loads are no longer refused in games that map memory, remap GPU buffers or reserve GPU address space as they play.
  - After a load, the 3D scene is no longer black, the audio no longer buzzes, scene changes no longer wait forever, and frames are no longer dropped.
  - Threads the game started after the save no longer block the load.

- **Lemon FG, Lemon's own frame generation.** Built in, nothing to install, and no Lossless Scaling code in it: turn it on in Settings → Graphics → Frame generation, for all games or one. A new **Engine** option picks Lemon FG (default) or Lossless Scaling, which only runs with your own copy of `Lossless.dll`. The FPS counter shows which one is working, and Lemon FG has its own lemon icon. The setup screen explains that Lemon FG is included instead of only offering to load the DLL.
- **Accurate is the default GPU mode again** in Lemon: the optimizations in this version pay for most of its cost (measured: TOTK 48.1 → 47.9 fps on an AYN Odin 3, BOTW 16.6 → 17.0 fps on a Galaxy S24 Ultra). Lemon Lite and Lemon Lite & Spoofed keep Fast.
- **One lighter wait for the GPU.** Lemon still waits for the GPU before a game reuses what was drawn, so the flickering fixed in 1.1 stays fixed, but it no longer drains the GPU when the game waits for work that is already queued (Garfield: GPU thread stalls from ~156 to ~13 ms per second). releases.body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

v2.0.1 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

A stability and hygiene patch for v2.0.0, focused on the crash and antivirus reports from the first few hours.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Stability

- Fixed a crash on Linux and macOS where the game could die suddenly during gameplay when world streaming revoked memory the renderer was reading
- Fixed distant demoted tree trunks rendering with a flat blue texture

#### Antivirus false positives

- The Windows executable and runtime DLL now carry proper version metadata, and the runtime no longer contains any ability to create executable memory (it never used it - all game code is compiled at build time); both changes target the machine-learning heuristics some antivirus engines were tripping on
- A false-positive report has been filed with Microsoft for the v2.0.0 files; if your antivirus quarantined the runtime, restore it or re-download this release

#### Diagnostics

- The game now logs its exact build version at startup, so support logs identify the build they came from

The entire game renders natively at close visual parity with the console output, with a set of optional modern graphics enhancements that seek to go beyond it.

The new native renderer is early and is likely to have issues, I haven't tested the game all the way through.

releases.body:
This release candidate completes support for the cheat instructions implemented by Eden's DMNT engine and improves cheat-file parsing and process targeting.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.
- **Cheat execution:** corrected nested if/else handling, loop decoding, arithmetic behavior, and handling of truncated or unknown instructions. Controller input is sampled once per execution so multiple button conditions see the same input state.
- **Cheat files and process targeting:** fixed parsing of names containing Unicode symbols or accents. Memory operations and pause/resume now target the process identified by the cheat metadata, with a cached non-owning process reference.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc7
releases.body:
This release candidate fixes several cheat-engine decoding errors, adds missing process-memory service calls, and addresses an applet command that caused some game to abort.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc6.

### What's new since rc6

- **Cheat execution:** corrected data widths, register selection, immediate values, and pointer-chain offsets. These errors could prevent loaded cheats from taking effect.
- **Process-memory services:** wired `SetProcessMemoryPermission`, `MapProcessMemory`, and `UnmapProcessMemory` into both ARM64 and ARM32 system-call dispatch. Aligned permission handling and validation order with Eden, with tests for writable aliases, unmapping, and error handling. This addresses missing calls needed by injected cheat modules; end-to-end compatibility with third-party CheatVM modules is not yet verified.
- **Applet compatibility:** added Eden's success response for `ILibraryAppletAccessor` command 90. Also implemented `GetLibraryAppletInfo` to return the child applet's identity and mode.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc6
releases.body:
This release candidate fixes an audio-update parsing error that could cause invalid mixer data and audio glitches.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc5.

### What’s new since rc5

- **Audio update parsing:** the audio renderer now respects the splitter block size declared in the update header. Previously, it could read the following mixer block at the wrong offset, resulting in invalid mix counts or rejected audio updates.
- **Input validation:** added bounds checks for declared splitter blocks.
- **Regression coverage:** added synthetic tests covering splitter block boundaries, subsequent mixer updates, and header layout.

This correction addresses a likely cause of the audio errors reported in [issue #21](https://github.com/vricosti/ruzu-emu/issues/21). Confirmation through extended gameplay is still needed.

### Known limitations

Unsupported shader instructions may still cause missing graphics or prevent a scene from rendering. This release does not resolve every freeze, black-screen issue, or audio glitch.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc5
releases.body:
**This release candidate improves shader error handling, Windows build support, and diagnostics for freezes and black screens.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes the improvements from rc1 through rc4.

### What’s new since rc4

- **Shader stability:** unsupported shader instructions now produce an error that the Vulkan pipeline compiler can handle, rather than terminating the GPU worker. This improves error recovery but does not add support for those instructions.
- **Graphics compatibility:** aligned constant-buffer and texture validation with Eden and corrected how constant-buffer values are recorded for shader caching.
- **Windows memory handling:** aligned unsupported memory-protection handling with Eden, avoiding an unconditional panic.
- **Windows builds:** improved detection of existing Visual Studio installations and installation of missing C++ tools. Runtime DLLs are now copied alongside the build binaries, and a vcpkg compatibility fix was added.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc4
releases.body:
This release candidate adds support for multi-program titles such as game collections and fixes an ordering problem in kernel thread termination.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes the improvements from rc1, rc2 and rc3.

### What’s new since rc3

- **Game collections:** titles that chain into a sub-program (`ExecuteProgram`) now work. Previously, picking a game from a collection’s menu left the screen frozen at 0 FPS. Ruzu now shuts the running program down and boots the requested program of the same file. 
- **Kernel:** thread termination now signals completion and notifies waiting threads under the scheduler lock, after the terminating thread has left its core. This closes an ordering window between the two notifications.

### Known limitations

Only the collection listed above was tested with the new sub-program launch path. Other multi-program titles may still expose missing behavior, and reports are welcome.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tixul/Ngpcraft_emulator/compare/v3.8.9...v3.9.1

NgpCraft Emulator v3.9.0 - what's new
This release is about playing two players over the internet. It is still being tested, but the
first results are encouraging. If you play online, both of you should update, and please tell us
how it goes.

Online play in mirror mode should be smoother
Less input lag at the start of a match. The player who finished loading first used to start alone and wait for the other one. That wait made the emulator think the connection was slower than it really was, and it could add noticeable delay to that player's controls for several minutes. Both sides now start together. This idea comes from Blueteemo, who proposed it in pull request #26. Thank you!
Fewer freezes on a connection that loses packets. Your button presses are now also sent a second way, repeated several times, so a single lost packet should no longer freeze both screens. In our tests on a deliberately bad connection, most of the short freezes went away.
If the other player has an older version, the match should still work, just without these improvements.

# Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0

基于 [Winlator 11.1](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) 深度定制:

## 主要变化
- **Wine 10.10 -> Wine 11.15**: 移植 brunodev85 全部定制补丁 (Android 存储符号链接、GPU 信息上报、X11 窗口属性等) 至 Wine 11.15 新 WoW64 模式 (x86_64-unix + i386/x86_64 双架构 PE)
- **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好
- **完整中文支持**:
  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名
  - rootfs 注入 zh_CN.UTF-8 locale (glibc + X11)
  - Wine 前缀注册表中文字体替换 (宋体/SimSun -> Noto Sans CJK SC)
  - 新建容器默认中文环境

## 下载安装
直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。

## 技术说明
- APK 为 debug 签名, 与官方 Winlator 签名不同, 两者不可互相覆盖安装
- 由 GitHub Actions 全自动云端编译: Wine (约 50 分钟) -> rootfs 注入中文化 -> Gradle 打包
- 构建配方见仓库 `wine/`、`chinese/`、`.github/workflows/build.yml`

# Ymir v0.4.0
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/54fead6/)

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

Performance got another huge boost in multiple avenues with this version. First, thanks to @SternXD, you can now offload audio processing tasks to another CPU core, freeing up the emulator thread to focus more heavily on the SH-2s and general system logic. This alone can boost performance by up to 25% and possibly more, depending on how much work is put on the SCSP DSP.

releases.body:
- Restored the original pre-WebView native Android launcher and its `javac`/`d8`/`aapt2` packaging, removing the rejected Compose/Web presentation stack without changing game settings, drivers, mods, saves, touch editing, updates, or the diagnostic-tour gesture. The corrected artifact subsequently reached gameplay in user testing; controlled performance and broad-device outcomes remain separate questions.
- Added default helicopter **DESCEND** (`V`), an independent numbered **123** touch pad, and **ABC** paged PC keyboard input through SDL. Existing custom-layout indices and Extra buttons behavior are preserved. Added optional fixed Landscape/Reverse recovery while keeping Auto orientation by default.

The Prototype-style Mods library includes covers, descriptions, installed/active state, background imports and lifecycle operations, next-Play enable/disable, confirmed removal, and native-plugin trust confirmation. - Код перевода графики теперь собирается с более сильной оптимизацией. В основном это поможет телефонам, где он ограничивает частоту кадров (MediaTek / Mali, Snapdragon среднего класса).

Mods now really override the game, a weapon swap button, tappable character creation and smoother play.

## English

**PC mods**
- The mod manager moved to the pause menu (gear → *Mods…*).
- Mods now override the game's own files (outfits, textures, models), and a mod lower in the list overrides the ones above it.
- After you enable, disable or reorder mods, the game offers to restart right away.
- Tested with a texture mod and two new playable classes (Cacklespit, Werewolf).

**Controls**
- New ⇄ button (top right, next to L3) swaps your weapon sets in the field. In the side layout it is the ← cell.
- Character creation: the arrows for class, look, pet and difficulty work by tap.
- Fixed a crash when changing gender for classes that have only one body type (e.g. modded classes).
- The touch controls redraw only when something changes: less work for the phone while a finger is on the screen.
- New launcher icon.

**Performance**
- The game's background worker threads no longer wake the CPU tens of thousands of times a second while idle: lower CPU load and less heat.

# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2

releases.body:
**A test release: one rendering change for tile-based GPUs and two new log lines.** ARM64, Android 10 (API 29) or newer, Vulkan. Installs over v0.2.3 and keeps your saves.

## Changes

- **The final pass no longer loads the screen image first.** The last pass of every frame (gamma and rotation) draws every pixel of the screen image, so its old contents are not read back any more. This matters on tile-based GPUs: Mali, and Adreno with the stock driver or Turnip in GMEM mode. How much time it saves is **not measured yet** — that is what this release is for. It follows the launcher switch *Optimized render passes (Vulkan)*: with the switch off the image is loaded as before.
- **`[fps]` line in every log.** Once a minute `log.txt` gets a line with the frame rate, the average and the worst frame time, the number of frames longer than 100 ms and 1 s, GPU time, render scale and the FPS cap. *Performance log* does not have to be on for it.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Android ARM64 update focused on memory controls, graphics settings, driver management, and crash diagnostics.

## Changes

- Add Auto, Normal, Reduced, and Minimum memory modes. Automatic selection adapts to available device RAM without overwriting saved graphics preferences.
- Show a one-time low-memory warning when Android reports 7.5 GiB of RAM or less.
- Add model detail and building model quality controls, with both defaulting to their lowest levels. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Improve geometry simplification and graphics profile handling, and show output resolution in pixels and percentages.
- Restore normal city updates and rendering while paused by removing forced update suppression and frozen-frame reuse.
- Support landscape and reverse landscape only, including gamepad attachment and the crash monitor.
- Bundle one shared purple-turnip T30 driver for GPU checks and gameplay, with Mesa license text and driver provenance included.
- Add Turnip release browsing and downloads with byte progress and cancellation. Cache verified downloads for offline reuse and allow removal of unused external drivers while preserving the active driver.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Launcher compatibility update for Frostpunk for Android.

## Changes

- Keep the launcher usable when the device or selected renderer cannot run the game.
- Show insufficient Vulkan versions and missing GPU features in the Play card instead of a forced-exit dialog, including when game files are not yet installed.
- Preserve renderer selection and the compatibility checks that guard game startup.
- Update the APK to version `0.1.1-dev`, version code `3`.

## Installation and requirements

Download **Frostpunk-0.1.1-dev.apk** and its **.sha256** file from the assets below.
Install the APK, then select your supported Steam PC game folder or compatible stored ZIP in the launcher. Existing installations can be updated with the same Android signing certificate.

Running the game requires Android 11 or newer, a 64-bit ARM device, a compatible Vulkan 1.3 GPU and driver, and the player's own supported Steam PC game files. Adreno uses Turnip; supported Mali and PowerVR configurations use system Vulkan. An incompatible device can still open and use the launcher.

No original game files, extracted assets, saves, or game-data ZIPs are included in this release.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.1-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Frostpunk ARM64 port for Android with touch controls and Vulkan.

- Native ARM64 execution through static recompilation and a native host runtime.
- D3D11 rendering through DXVK, Turnip on Adreno, and supported system Vulkan on
  Mali and PowerVR.
- Localized GPU compatibility checks before launch.
- Touch camera controls, building placement, roads, keyboard input, and in-game
  port settings when the matching UI resources are present.
- Folder import and direct reads from compatible stored ZIP archives.
- On-device DXT-to-ASTC preparation, quality checks, and launch after conversion.
- PC snow and terrain by default, independent Switch graphics groups, and texture
  quality selection.
- System-language defaults, guarded 200% UI scale, and saved-setting preservation.

Requires Android 11+, compatible ARM64 Vulkan 1.3 hardware, and the supported Steam
PC game files supplied by the player. Original game files and optional extracted
assets are not distributed here. Device and scenario coverage is incomplete;
performance and long-session stability vary. Clean-clone APK reproduction is not
yet provided.

APK: `Frostpunk-0.1-dev.apk`

Package: `com.frostpunk.staticrecomp`
